_notes.form: Booking enquiries use NETLIFY FORMS (migrated from FormSubmit 6 Aug 2026). No endpoint, no third party, no activation step. 'name' must match both the form's name attribute and its hidden form-name field, or Netlify rejects the POST. Submissions are stored in the Netlify dashboard AND emailed. THE DESTINATION EMAIL IS NOT IN THIS FILE — it is set in the Netlify UI under Project configuration > Notifications > Form submission notifications, so it can be changed without a redeploy. It should be the 'email' value above. Netlify's free tier covers 100 submissions/month.
_notes.hours: Confirmed with Ash 31 July 2026: work hours 08:00-20:00 daily; phone and email answered 24/7.
